recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rename Signature.data to Signature.evidence without a new work-group decision, because FHIR-17466's final resolution points to FHIR-16998's Signature.data rename as the accepted disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-17466 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification security WG change request from STU3 asking to rename Signature.blob to Signature.evidence. Its final resolution did not select evidence; it recorded that FHIR-16998 had already renamed the element to Signature.data by FHIR-I.
initial_application: FHIR-16998, also Published and Persuasive with Modification, resolved to rename Binary.content to Binary.data and Signature.blob to Signature.data. Commit b96bbd292505dde0f56bdda132c7476d85b19de8 applied the Signature source rename in source/datatypes/signature.xml on 2018-07-19.
additional_context: Signature is listed as an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. Current source/datatypes/signature.xml defines Signature.data, source/signatures.html refers to Signature.data for JWS and XML signatures, and source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml exposes the Signature data element. The only current Signature.blob occurrence in build-relevant source is the intentional R3 compatibility map Signature.blob=Signature.data; other blob hits were historical release snapshots or non-Signature QUICK content. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct conflicting FHIR-17466/FHIR-16998 decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current build already reflects the final Jira outcome: Signature.data, with a backward-compatibility rename from Signature.blob.
